tplStep.description: Accessible name of the step dropdown on the template screen.

tplStepInitial.description: Step dropdown item for the first message of a sequence.

tplStepFollowUp.description: Step dropdown item for a follow-up message.

tplChannel.description: Accessible name of the channel dropdown (body or subject).

tplChannelBody.description: Channel dropdown item: the message body.

tplChannelSubject.description: Channel dropdown item: the e-mail subject line.

tplLocaleAria.description: Accessible name of the locale input.

tplLocaleLabel.description: Visible label next to the locale input. Lowercase on purpose.

tplSourcePlaceholder.message: {Hi|Hello} %name%, {quick|short} question about %topic% …  (paste a template from Studio or your chat; Ctrl+V works right here)
tplSourcePlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the template editor. Keep the spintax braces and the %name% / %topic% variables as they are; translate only the sentence in the parentheses.

tplVarsRawAria.description: Accessible name of the raw variables box. '#set' is engine syntax — keep it.

tplRowsAria.description: Accessible name of the number input that picks how many rows the preview renders.

tplTabList.description: Variables tab: values taken from the imported recipient list.

tplTabRaw.description: Variables tab: the same values as raw #set lines.

tplCopyRawTitle.message: Copy the #set lines — paste them into the playground or Studio
tplCopyRawTitle.description: Tooltip of the button that copies the raw variables.

tplVarsCopied.description: Confirmation after the variables were copied to the clipboard.

tplClipboardBlocked.message: Clipboard blocked — select the text and copy it.
tplClipboardBlocked.description: Shown when the browser refused clipboard access.

tplCopy.description: Button that copies the raw variables.

tplSave.description: Primary button of the template screen.

tplUnsavedRestored.description: Shown when the editor text kept from a previous visit was put back.

tplRemoveInclude.description: Accessible name of the button that removes one include file.

tplNoIncludes.description: Shown instead of the include chips when the template has none.

tplErrorsOne.description: Error count in the template status line.

tplErrorsFew.description: Error count in the template status line.

tplErrorsMany.description: Error count in the template status line.

tplErrorsOther.description: Error count in the template status line.

tplWarningsOne.description: Warning count in the template status line.

tplWarningsFew.description: Warning count in the template status line.

tplWarningsMany.description: Warning count in the template status line.

tplWarningsOther.description: Warning count in the template status line.

tplEngineTitle.description: Tooltip of the status line: which engine build validated the template.

diagVariableUndefined.message: %$NAME$% is not a column or profile field — rename it or add a column
diagVariableUndefined.description: Engine diagnostic in user words: the template uses a variable the campaign does not know. The percent signs are spintax syntax — keep them around the name.

diagVariableUndefinedAnon.message: this variable is not a column or profile field — rename it or add a column
diagVariableUndefinedAnon.description: Same diagnostic when the engine did not report which variable it was.

diagUnclosed.description: Engine diagnostic in user words: an unclosed or unbalanced brace.

diagEmptyAlternative.message: Empty alternative on line $LINE$ — remove the extra "|"
diagEmptyAlternative.description: Engine diagnostic in user words: two pipes with nothing between them. The pipe is spintax syntax — keep it.

tplValid.description: Success panel shown when the engine reported no diagnostics.

tplSeverityError.description: Badge on a diagnostic that blocks saving.

tplSeverityWarning.description: Badge on a diagnostic that does not block saving.

varsGroupTarget.description: Variables table group: the column that holds the contact page or address.

varsGroupLang.description: Variables table group: the column that holds the row language.

varsGroupColumn.description: Variables table group: an ordinary column of the list.

varsGroupProfile.description: Variables table group: a constant from the sender profile.

varsGroupDerived.description: Variables table group: a value the extension computes itself (key, domain, today).

varsGroupMissing.description: Variables table group: used in the template but unknown to the campaign.

tplVarNotInCampaign.description: Sample-value cell of a variable the campaign does not define.

tplVarUsed.description: Flag on a variable the template actually uses.

tplVarUnused.description: Flag on a variable the campaign has but the template does not use.

tplVarAdd.description: Flag on a missing variable with no near-match to rename it to.

tplRenameTo.description: Button that rewrites a misspelled variable to the nearest known one. The percent signs are spintax syntax — keep them around the name.

tplAddColumnTitle.message: Add a column with this variable or a profile constant
tplAddColumnTitle.description: Tooltip of the 'add' flag on a missing variable.

tplVarsFromRow.description: Hint under the variables table: which row the sample values come from.

tplVarsNoRows.message: Import a list to see sample values.
tplVarsNoRows.description: Hint under the variables table when no list has been imported yet.

tplVarsConstructs.message: Constructs: $LIST$ (an estimate, not a variant count).
tplVarsConstructs.description: Hint under the variables table: which spintax constructs the template uses. The list itself is engine vocabulary and stays English.

tplErrorBannerTitle.description: Title of the banner that replaces the preview while the template does not compile.

tplNoRows.message: Import a list to render real rows — each row gets its own wording from the same template.
tplNoRows.description: Empty state of the variants list.

tplSeed.description: The deterministic seed a preview variant was rendered with.

tplCopyVariant.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the copy button on a preview variant.

tplVariantCopied.description: Confirmation after one preview variant was copied.

tplRespinTitle.message: Another variant of every row (preview only — the queue keeps the row seed)

tplRespin.description: Button that re-renders the preview with a different variant per row.

tplPlaygroundTitle.message: Open this template in the spintax.net playground with a sample row as variables
tplPlaygroundTitle.description: Tooltip of the playground button. 'spintax.net' is a domain — keep it.

tplTooLongForLink.message: Too long for a link — save it as .spintax and open the file in Studio.
tplTooLongForLink.description: Shown when the template does not fit into a playground URL.

tplPlayground.description: Button that opens the template in the spintax.net playground.

tplSaveFileTitle.message: Save as a .spintax file — opens in Spintax Studio, VS Code or Sublime
tplSaveFileTitle.description: Tooltip of the download button. The product names stay as they are.

tplSaveFile.description: Button that downloads the template as a .spintax file. The extension stays as it is.

tplStudioTitle.message: Spintax Studio — the full offline editor (Windows); load the saved .spintax there
tplStudioTitle.description: Tooltip of the Spintax Studio link. The product name stays as it is.

tplStudioLink.description: Link to the desktop editor. Product name — keep it as it is.

tplClearTitle.message: Clear the editor (the saved template stays until you save again)

tplClear.description: Button that empties the template editor.

tplSaved.description: Confirmation after the template was stored.

tplTemplate.description: Label of the template editor block and accessible name of its section.

tplLoadFile.description: Label of the file picker that fills the editor from a file.

tplAddIncludes.description: Label of the file picker that attaches #include files.

tplVariables.description: Label of the variables block and accessible name of its tab list.

tplVariants.description: Accessible name of the preview section.

tplVariantsHead.description: Label of the preview block: one variant per row of the imported list.

tplRowsLabel.description: Label of the input that picks how many rows the preview renders. Lowercase on purpose.

tplWarnEmptyVariable.message: %$NAME$% is empty and has no fallback
tplWarnEmptyVariable.description: Render warning under a variant. The percent signs are spintax syntax — keep them around the name.

tplWarnLeakedMarkup.description: Render warning under a variant: spintax syntax survived into the rendered text.

tplWarnRenderError.description: Render warning under a variant. The message comes from the engine and stays English.

aiSummary.message: Write the template with AI — no keys, your own chat
aiSummary.description: Summary line of the collapsible 'write with AI' section.

aiIntroBuilt.message: The prompt is built from your columns (names, samples, empty-cell guards, hints) with the canonical Spintax authoring prompt.
aiIntroBuilt.description: First sentence of the AI section intro.

aiIntroPaste.message: Copy it into any chat, paste the answer into the template box above — it is validated on paste.
aiIntroPaste.description: Second sentence of the AI section intro.

aiIntroOpenIn.message: "Open in …" buttons prefill the chat with the prompt in the URL; you still press Send there.
aiIntroOpenIn.description: Third sentence of the AI section intro. 'Open in …' quotes the buttons below it.

aiBriefLabel.description: Label of the textarea where the user describes the message they want.

aiBriefPlaceholder.message: What should the message do? Audience, offer, tone — one or two sentences. Add a line about tone if you like.

aiChannel.description: Accessible name of the channel dropdown in the AI section.

aiChannelGeneric.description: AI channel dropdown item: a website contact form or chat widget.

aiChannelEmail.description: AI channel dropdown item: an e-mail message.

aiChannelSms.description: AI channel dropdown item: SMS or a messenger with a tight limit.

aiVariation.description: Accessible name of the dropdown that picks how much the wording should vary.

aiVariationBalanced.description: Variation dropdown item: the default amount of variation.

aiVariationConservative.description: Variation dropdown item: few alternatives, close wording.

aiVariationAggressive.description: Variation dropdown item: many alternatives, wider wording.

aiIncludeSamples.message: include sample values from the list
aiIncludeSamples.description: Checkbox that adds real sample values to the prompt. Lowercase on purpose.

aiPromptLabel.message: Prompt (editable — this is exactly what gets copied)
aiPromptLabel.description: Label of the prompt preview textarea.

aiCopyPrompt.description: Primary button of the AI section.

aiOpenChatGpt.description: Link that opens ChatGPT with the prompt prefilled. Product name — keep it as it is.

aiOpenClaude.description: Link that opens Claude Desktop with the prompt prefilled. Product name — keep it as it is.

aiCopyFixIt.description: Button that copies a prompt asking the chat to repair the broken template.

aiNoBrief.description: Shown when the copy button is pressed with an empty brief.

aiPromptCopied.message: Prompt copied — paste it into your chat (Ctrl+V), then paste the answer below.
aiPromptCopied.description: Confirmation after the authoring prompt was copied.

aiFixItCopied.message: Fix-it prompt copied — paste it into your chat (Ctrl+V), then paste the answer below.
aiFixItCopied.description: Confirmation after the repair prompt was copied.

aiClipboardBlocked.message: Clipboard blocked — select the text in the preview and copy it manually.
aiClipboardBlocked.description: Shown when the browser refused clipboard access in the AI section.
